title: Nine Rabbits by Virginia Zaharieva
description:
Novels & Nibbles takes us to the enchanting world of Nine Rabbits. Part novel, part memoir, and part cookbook set in the 1960s communist Bulgaria. It follows Manda, a sensitive girl, who is sent to live with her domineering and abusive grandmother. As she grows into womanhood, she discovers that the stories we inherit can nourish the soul, and recipes are more than instructions; they are heirlooms carrying stories of those who came before us. 

To accompany this unforgettable tale we are serving Apricot Dumplings. Tender apricot filled dumplings, gently boiled until pillowy soft, then tossed in rich butter and golden toasted breadcrumbs. Topped with succulent red wine-braised rabbit and served with velvety rabbit and wild mushroom gravy for spooning over every bite. This is a  rustic, comforting dish where sweet fruit, savory game, and earthy mushrooms come together in perfect harmony.

Come on by for a dish you’ll be talking about long after the last bite.
